title: Intersectional Sycophancy: How Perceived User Demographics Shape False Validation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differential sycophancy (false validation) rates by orchestrating multi-turn adversarial conversations with an auditor model playing user personas of different races (Black, White, Hispanic, Asian).
Measuring differential sycophancy rates by orchestrating multi-turn adversarial conversations with an auditor model playing user personas of different ages (ranging from 8 to 70 years old).
Measuring differential sycophancy rates by orchestrating multi-turn adversarial conversations with an auditor model playing user personas of different genders (boy/girl, man/woman).

Measuring differential sycophancy rates by orchestrating multi-turn adversarial conversations with an auditor model playing user personas expressing different levels of confidence (extremely confident vs. deeply insecure).
